svg.title: Book Tracker backend request and event paths
svg.desc: Independent rows show public delivery, metadata lookup, shared-catalog search and reader summaries, operator curation, telemetry, Toggl synchronization, and lifecycle cleanup. Every deployed function appears by its deployed name with its authorization boundary and main data dependencies.
